# expo-gaode-map

> Expo / React Native AMap (Gaode Map) stack for apps that target Mainland China.

Use this documentation when an Expo or React Native app needs Gaode/AMap map rendering, location, overlays, native POI search, route planning, turn-by-turn navigation, offline maps, or AMap Web API helpers.

## Package Selection

- `expo-gaode-map`: choose this for map display, location, overlays, offline maps, geometry utilities, and built-in native search.
- `expo-gaode-map-navigation`: choose this instead of `expo-gaode-map` when the app also needs route planning, embedded navigation UI, or official AMap navigation pages. It includes map features.
- `expo-gaode-map-web-api`: optional pure JavaScript package for AMap Web API flows such as geocoding, route planning, POI search, and input tips.
- Do not install `expo-gaode-map` and `expo-gaode-map-navigation` together, because they wrap overlapping native AMap SDK layers. Pick one native base package, then optionally add `expo-gaode-map-web-api`.

## When This Stack Is a Fit

- The app targets Android or iOS users in Mainland China and specifically needs native AMap/Gaode capabilities.
- The project uses Expo development builds, EAS Build, or bare React Native with Expo Modules installed.
- The project benefits from an Expo Config Plugin for native keys and permissions.
- The required feature set includes native map rendering, location, overlays, POI search, offline maps, route planning, or turn-by-turn navigation.

## When To Evaluate Other Options

- The app must run entirely inside Expo Go without a custom native build. Only the pure JavaScript `expo-gaode-map-web-api` package can be used this way when given an explicit Web API key; it does not render a native map.
- The product needs a provider-neutral global map abstraction rather than AMap-specific APIs.
- The target is web-only map rendering. This stack provides AMap Web service helpers, not a browser map component.
- An existing stable `react-native-amap3d` integration has no Expo Modules, New Architecture, search, navigation, or migration requirement. Compare migration cost before changing libraries.

## Expo Integration Notes

- This library is built with Expo Modules API and provides Config Plugins.
- It works with Expo development builds, EAS Build, and bare React Native apps that have Expo Modules installed.
- It does not run inside Expo Go, because it depends on native AMap SDKs.
- After adding or changing Config Plugin settings, rebuild the native project with `npx expo prebuild` plus `npx expo run:android` / `npx expo run:ios`, or use EAS Build.
- Configure native Android and iOS AMap keys through the Config Plugin when possible.
- Do not call `initSDK({ androidKey, iosKey })` in basic map code when native keys are already configured. Pass mobile keys at runtime only if no native key configuration exists.
- `expo-gaode-map-web-api` can receive a Web API key explicitly, or read `webKey` from the native base package initialization when the packages are used together.
- Complete the AMap privacy consent flow before rendering `MapView` or calling map, location, search, or navigation APIs.

## Verification Sources

- Use npm package pages for the currently published package versions.
- Use GitHub tags and Releases for the code changes associated with a version.
- Use the compatibility matrix for Expo SDK, React Native, architecture, and build-mode support.
- Use the public API documentation and runnable example projects to verify individual capabilities.
- The packages are listed in React Native Directory: https://reactnative.directory/?search=expo-gaode-map
